author: GamingBolt
description:
In any video game, but especially so in Control Resonant, space is finite. The paranatural occurrences, the calamities, the dimensions that Dylan (and Jesse) roam in certainly seem endless. However, even for Remedy's “biggest and most ambitious game ever,” the virtual walls that encompass the play space are finite. It's not a detriment by any means – if anything, the developer's ability to leverage that space, and tell interesting stories, ultimately makes (and sometimes breaks) the developer's works for some. The “peak Remedy weirdness”, as it were.

Which is why I need to rave about the Underpass in Control Resonant. In my review, I called it one of my favorite video game environments this year, and upon deeper thought, I wouldn't be surprised if it tops the list.
title: Control Resonant's Underpass Is A MASTERCLASS

author: GamingBolt
description:
Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve is certainly an ambitious game, as is evidenced by the fact that its campaign is quite easily the longest one that the mainline series has seen since its inception. 

However, this ambition also ended up being the source of my biggest problems with the game, especially when it came to the slow middle act, plethora of bombing missions, and a final mission that feels like a massive let down after some fantastic boss battles. Despite this, however, I still thoroughly enjoyed my time with the game, and pacing issues aside, firmly find this to be a noticeable upgrade over its predecessor.
title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
While the “official” data isn't out yet, Xbox sources reportedly told The Verge that pre-orders for the game are “heavily skewed” to PS5. Keep in mind that the sheer number of pre-orders for Grand Theft Auto 6 – which Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick called “unprecedented and astonishing” could ensure that the Series X/S is still getting a hefty amount. But even if we assume “heavily” means 70 to 30, it's still incredibly underwhelming for a console whose revenue has constantly declined and is now in its most challenging period yet, with memory shortages, price hikes, layoffs, restructuring, and a clear lack of a plan.

Then again, it begs another question: Why are so many pre-ordering on PlayStation 5 in the first place?
title: GTA 6 - What The Hell Is Going On With Its PS5 And Xbox Pre-Orders?
